svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The share of US Google searches ending without a click has risen
svg.desc: Two bars to scale. In 2024, 60.45 percent of US Google searches ended without a click. Between January and April 2026 the figure was 68.01 percent, on SparkToro's analysis of Similarweb clickstream data.
svg.text: US GOOGLE SEARCHES THAT END WITHOUT A CLICK
SparkToro's analysis of Similarweb clickstream data, January to April 2026, against 2024.
Traffic is a proxy for the goal, and it is a proxy that has got worse.
The results page answers the question and nobody goes anywhere.
